title: Motorcycle vs bus: 2 teen cousins dead in Bohol crash

blocks.text: ​GARCIA HERNANDEZ, Bohol — Two 15-year-old cousins died after the motorcycle they were riding collided head-on with a passenger bus along the national highway in Purok 7, Barangay West-Canayaon, Garcia-Hernandez town, in Bohol Province on Sunday noon, September 20. The police identified the victims as two 15-year-old boys, who were cousins and residents of Barangay West Poblacion of the town. READ: EXPLAINER: Why ‘innocent’ drivers get arrested in road accidents Initial investigation showed that the two cousins were traveling fast on their motorcycle toward the neighboring town of Jagna.
